data.body:
AC amendment: DD3 gap + DD4 tautology + DD5 completeness.

DD3 gap: Add 3 missing structural hook tests:
  - test_structural_check_shim_refs_runs_on_ci: check-shim-refs.sh runs despite enforcement.strategy=ci
  - test_structural_check_contract_schemas_runs_on_ci: check-contract-schemas.sh runs despite enforcement.strategy=ci
  - test_structural_check_referential_integrity_runs_on_ci: check-referential-integrity.sh runs despite enforcement.strategy=ci

DD4 positive assertion: Alongside test_enforcement_both_no_double_execution (asserts not twice), add positive assertion that hook ran ONCE (not zero). Use invocation counter file in tmpdir:
  COUNTER_FILE=/hook_invocations
  # After hook run under enforcement.strategy=both:
  assert_eq 'test_enforcement_both_runs_once' '1' ""

DD5 completeness: Add test_hook_gate_schema_test_quality_gate to assert pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh emits HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci with format identical to review-gate and test-gate.

.test-index entries required (all 8 original + 4 new test functions):
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_enforcement_ci_review_gate_skips]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_enforcement_ci_test_gate_skips]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_enforcement_ci_test_quality_gate_skips]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_structural_check_plugin_self_ref_runs_on_ci]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_structural_check_portability_runs_on_ci]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_structural_check_shim_refs_runs_on_ci]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_structural_check_contract_schemas_runs_on_ci]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_structural_check_referential_integrity_runs_on_ci]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_enforcement_both_no_double_execution]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_enforcement_both_runs_once]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_hook_gate_schema_review_gate]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_hook_gate_schema_test_gate]
  tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh [test_hook_gate_schema_test_quality_gate]
Plus source-file mappings for all gating hooks (review-gate, test-gate, test-quality-gate) and structural hooks (check-plugin-self-ref, check-portability, check-shim-refs, check-contract-schemas, check-referential-integrity).
